newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,089.50.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dlr at 1,089.50.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended lower against the dollar at 1,089.50 after a session marked by strong demand for U.S. currency, interbank dealers said.

They said selling of dollars by oil, coal and coffee exporters limited the peso's losses. But it ended down 2.95 pesos from Tuesday's close on demand for greenbacks from banks and the corporate sector, including some multinationals.
Dealers reported 307 trades for a total of $143 million and said the peso hit an intraday low of 1,090.50 before trending slightly higher into the close.
